acceptance.given: The Package B handoff table is being created or updated.

oracle.expected: The table records the accepted quality contract and CLI, legacy behavior, and expected migration touchpoints for each of the five Skills; preserves existing authority and the optional status of Bootstrap Review; excludes BMAD/GDS/Chapter 2-7 Skills; and does not make Package A completion depend on the five Skills passing the new standard or enable an internal reviewer.
forbidden: Any of the five Skills lacks the accepted quality contract, CLI, legacy behavior, or expected migration touchpoints.
The table changes existing authority, makes Bootstrap Review mandatory, enables an internal reviewer, or makes Package A completion depend on the five real Skills passing the new standard.
The table includes excluded BMAD, GDS, or Chapter 2-7 Skills.
oracle.observable: During contract or terminal validation, an artifact check inspects the Package B handoff table and verifies its five Skill entries and the specified contract, migration, authority, Bootstrap Review, scope, and completion-gate boundaries.

acceptance.then: The artifact check confirms the table contains the required five-Skill handoff and preserves the specified boundaries.
acceptance.when: During contract or terminal validation, inspect the handoff-table artifact and evaluate its content against the A25 requirements; this is an artifact check, not a runtime validator result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_migration.py::test_a25 checks the handoff table artifact and fails when a required Skill entry, handoff field, or stated boundary is missing or contradictory.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Document the A25 Package B handoff table in the authoring standard and add its artifact-content assertion to the migration test module.
forbidden_paths: historical Bootstrap, TDD, acceptance, freeze, or implementation reports

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Documentation-only handoff content; no runtime state or schema changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: The Package B handoff table progresses from not recording the accepted five-Skill quality contract to recording it with the required migration details and authority boundaries.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The A25 artifact assertion passes against the handoff table, confirming all five Skill entries and every specified handoff and scope boundary.
